owner: contract: Claude design agent; RTL + exact adapter proof: Codex /root/s81/pq_parent

pins.name: clk
pins.meaning: column clock (stream_1p2 region root at the column FIFO); 833.333 ps

pins.name: rst_n
pins.meaning: async assert, sync deassert from the column reset synchroniser

pins.name: tree_in[0]
pins.meaning: word valid; no ready, at most one word a cycle

pins.name: tree_par
pins.meaning: odd parity over tree_in[65:1]; meaningful when tree_in[0]

pins.name: upstream_fault
pins.meaning: column / tree fault, ORed into fault (as ot_s81_pq_root_adapter)

pins.name: r_v
pins.meaning: row valid; at most one a cycle; no ready

pins.name: r_bf16
pins.meaning: RNE of r_fp32 (rb = fp32 + 0x7FFF + fp32[16]; bits 31:16)

pins.name: r_par
pins.meaning: odd parity over {r_row, r_pos, r_fp32, r_bf16, r_e} (68 b); meaningful when r_v

pins.name: fault
pins.meaning: sticky: OR of native faults, protection faults and upstream_fault

face.reconciliation: native 66 in (i_v, i_t, i_d, i_e) + 69 out (r_v, r_row, r_pos, r_fp32, r_bf16, r_e) + fault + clk + rst_n = 138; + tree_par + r_par (protection) + upstream_fault (adapter OR, already in ot_s81_pq_root_adapter) = 141. The design draft's 67/71 counted parity + {fault, busy}; busy is NOT a root port (column busy stays on the column FIFO path)

timing.inputs: tree_in, tree_par: pin -> input station flop (inside the 142.56 um strip, <= 100 um) with at most buffering; launched by the producer station <= 215 um away; budget: external <= 833.3 - 60 (setup unc) - 15 (accept) - 120 (station internal) = 638 ps
timing.outputs: r_*, r_par, fault: output station flop -> pin, at most buffering (<= 120 ps internal); consumer is the RWB stage-0 register through the return-trunk stations
timing.reset: rst_n is a reset tree input, not timed as data; deassertion synchronised at the column root
timing.hold: FF +15 ps with 25 ps hold uncertainty on every registered face

protocol.tree_in: valid-only, no backpressure (native); the producer guarantees occupancy <= QD = 128; overflow is the native queue fault
protocol.r: valid-only, no ready (native); consumer (RWB) FIFO >= max rows per region per phase (14) accepts every cycle
protocol.fault: level, sticky until rst_n, registered; the cycle after it is set r_v is held 0 (fail closed)

parity.sense: odd: data bits XOR parity bit has odd weight (an all-zero word with p = 0 is an error, so stuck-at-0 words and dead drivers are caught)

domains.name: face in
domains.protected: tree_in[65:1] = {e, d, tag} (65 b) with tree_par
domains.generated: producer: the last return-stage register of the column tree (dsfd_rstg / node output register) - NOT in RTL today: an obligation on the tree-return owner; fallback: generate in the root input station (then the die wire is unprotected and documented)
domains.checked: root input station register, every cycle with tree_in[0] = 1
domains.on_error: word dropped (not enqueued), sticky fault cause IN

domains.name: queue
domains.protected: qt/qd/qe entry (65 b) + 1 parity bit (the face parity carried, not regenerated: end-to-end from the producer)
domains.checked: stage A when the entry becomes the candidate (FWFT head register carries it)
domains.on_error: candidate dropped, sticky fault cause Q

domains.name: buffer
domains.generated: queue-sourced candidate: its carried bit; adder-sourced candidate: generated in stage A from {st tag, sum, e} (the adder and tag-delay pipelines are logic, not storage: unprotected, disclosed)
domains.checked: stage B on the hit entry (the bd one-hot read also returns bt, be, p); stage B re-checks the A->B candidate register
domains.on_error: no add issued, sticky fault cause BUF / AB
domains.note: a tag upset that turns a match into a miss leaves the entry stranded: caught by the spine rows-left watchdog (system obligation), not by parity

domains.name: bv
domains.scheme: kept shadow copy bv_s (not parity): any bv != bv_s -> sticky fault cause BV (checked every cycle)

domains.name: queue counters
domains.scheme: invariant (qw - qr) mod 128 == qc mod 128 every cycle -> sticky fault cause QC

domains.name: face out
domains.protected: {r_row, r_pos, r_fp32, r_bf16, r_e} (68 b) with r_par
domains.generated: stage B from the D-inputs of the output register (after the A->B parity re-check, so coverage is contiguous; the RNE incrementer is logic, unprotected)
domains.on_error: RWB drops the write, RWB sticky fault -> spine f_fault

storage_bits.native_layout: queue QD x {t32,d32,e} + buffer D x {bv,t32,d32,e}

parity.design_draft_correction: the d95 draft counted 256 parity bits (2 x 128) and no bv shadow; the contract adds the 128-bit bv shadow and 3 pipe/station bits: 16,768 + 387 = 17,155 bits per root

fail_closed.sticky: cause register {IN, Q, BUF, AB, BV, QC, QOVF (native queue), BFULL (native buffer), UP} cleared only by rst_n; fault pin = OR, registered
blocks: the faulting word is never published or used (dropped at its check point)
from the cycle after any cause is set, r_v is forced 0 (no further publication from this root)
RWB ORs fault into the spine f_fault: the spine fault is sticky, ready stays low (no new go), the controller aborts/replays the token
adder results still in flight are discarded with the suppression
fail_closed.native_difference: native keeps publishing after a fault; post-fault output is outside the golden contract, so suppression is allowed and required here

stages.name: queue (FWFT)
stages.regs: 128 x 66 entry array + qr/qw/qc + registered head (norm precomputed on the head load)
stages.logic: write decode; head load mux 128:1 x 66 (7 levels) + norm (3 levels)

stages.name: A (select + match)
stages.regs: cand 65 + p + M_raw[128] + fwd + complete + valid
stages.logic: sv/head 2:1 mux; candidate tag fan-out to 128 comparators via 8 kept copies (16 each); 27-bit equality {pos,row,k,nseg} + lo XOR == 1<<k; AND-reduce; parity of adder results
stages.fanout: candidate tag bits: 8 kept copies x 16 comparators (owner rule: replicate)

stages.name: B (fix-up + decide)
stages.regs: hit/free one-hot -> bv/bv_s/bt/bd/be/p writes; add_a/add_b/tag_in; output register {row,pos,fp32,bf16,e,r_par}; prev decision (rm/ins one-hot, slot)
stages.logic: M = (M_raw & ~RM_prev) | (fwd & INS_prev ? onehot_prev); lowest-set priority (7 levels prefix OR + AND); lowest-free on current bv (parallel); bd/bt/be/p one-hot AND-OR read (7 levels) -> parity check (4) and operand order by ct.lo[k]; RNE 16-bit prefix increment (5)
stages.note: if B misses SS +15 ps: split the bd one-hot read into a stage C (operand fetch) - safe because a slot removed in B cannot be rewritten before C reads it (rewrite needs a later B) - +1 cycle on the add path only

hazard_rules: H1 insert-forward: the candidate in A at t compared against the buffer at the start of t; the candidate decided in B at t may insert into slot s at the end of t. fwd = sibling(B.cand.tag, A.cand.tag) is registered in A; in B at t+1 the match bit of s is set iff fwd and B(t) inserted into s.
H2 remove-mask: if B(t) removed slot s (paired it), the match bit of s is cleared for the candidate decided in B(t+1) (golden: bv[s] cleared before the next decision).
H3 free search uses the CURRENT bv in B (it includes B(t)'s write), never the A-time snapshot.
H4 only B(t) can write between the A compare of a candidate and its B decision, so H1-H3 are complete.
H5 operand order: left = the entry with the lower lo (= the hit entry iff ct.lo bit k is set); parent tag = norm({row, ct.lo & ~(1<<k), k+1, nseg}) computable from the candidate alone in A.

equivalence.pairing: identical: every add combines the same two golden siblings in the same operand order, so every published word is bit-identical to the native root's word for that row
equivalence.order: output ORDER and slot indices may differ (decisions are one cycle later, so adder results and queue heads interleave differently); the VM writes by address and the spine counts rows, so order is not observable
equivalence.faults: native overflow faults stay overflow faults; occupancy may differ transiently (reported as occ_max for both models)

latency.row_complete_extra: +1 per root decision on the row's critical chain: <= 1 + 3 (nseg <= 8 -> <= 3 root-level adds)

word_in_to_row_out.contracted: 2 + 1 (CAM) + 2 (stations) = 5 for a word that completes at once; + 1 per root-level add

state: add pipeline 5 stages + tag delay 5 x 33 b (registered issue: add, add_a, add_b, tag_in)
counters_and_rounding.rounding: stateless: r_bf16 = (r_fp32 + 0x7FFF + r_fp32[16])[31:16] computed in B from the registered candidate data, registered with r_par; no other rounding site
counters_and_rounding.pipelining: queue counters update in A (pop) and at the input station (push); bv/bv_s update in B; the add issue registers are written in B

reset.asserted: bv = bv_s = 0, qr = qw = qc = 0, A/B valid = 0, prev = none, add valid = 0, tag delay valid = 0, r_v = 0, cause = 0
reset.not_reset: entry arrays (qt/qd/qe/p, bt/bd/be/p): written before they become valid; parity is checked only on valid entries
reset.deassert: synchronous release from the column reset synchroniser; first word accepted 2 cycles after release
